subject: Kickoff: aptamer model training and sequence walking
body:
Hi Bruno, team,

Kicking off the aptamer modeling work. Four stages: data preprocessing, model training, sequence walking, and the analysis notebooks over PD and MLPD count data. Preprocessing takes raw fastq file pairs and produces a matrix of sequences with counts per pair — that is, per selection round and stringency level — and everything downstream keys off that matrix.

Product angle: the sequence-walking step is what a partner actually wants, a guided search from a known binder toward better ones.

Milestones: preprocessing and count matrices by early May, trained models plus walking runs late May, figure regeneration from the analysis notebooks in early June, readout the week of June 8.

Dmitri
